pkgmetadata.longdescription: CryptoPro CSP is a proprietary cryptographic service provider implementing the Russian GOST R 34.10-2001/2012, GOST R 34.11-94/2012 and GOST 28147-89 algorithms. It provides a CryptoAPI/CNG-like interface (libcapi20/libcapi10), PKCS#11, CAdES/XAdES, TLS via Nginx/Apache/stunnel and a large set of smart card and USB token drivers. The vendor binaries are installed below /opt/cprocsp and configured with cpconfig(8) in pkg_postinst.

use.flag: Install CAdES/XAdES libraries and the browser native messaging host (cprocsp-pki-cades, cprocsp-pki-plugin); requires gui.
Install the GTK3 cptools GUI and its MIME types.
Install the vendor's time-limited demo license (including the OCSP/TSP demo serials). Disable if you provision licenses yourself.
Import the system CA bundle into the CSP root store during configuration.
Install the KC1 provider (lsb-cprocsp-kc1), the normal local provider.
Install the KC2 client/server provider (lsb-cprocsp-kc2); it replaces KC1 and needs the cryptsrv service.
Install the PKCS#11 module (lsb-cprocsp-pkcs11), needed by browsers and gosuslugi.
Smart card driver for Accord readers (lsb-cprocsp-rdr-accord).
PC/SC reader support (cprocsp-rdr-pcsc); required by most token drivers.
Aktiv Rutoken driver plus the ifd-rutokens PC/SC bundle (needs readers_pcsc).
